(CSE: GGF) (OTC: NEWDF) (FSE: M4K0) ("Genesis Goldfields" or the "Company") is pleased to announce a non-brokered private placement financing of up to 13,333,333 units in the capital of the Company (each, a "Unit") at a price of $0.15 per Unit, for gross proceeds of up to $2,000,000 (the "Offering"). Each Unit purchased will include one common share and one-half of one transferable common share purchase warrant.
